decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-143 MODIFY already captures the separately stated Small Block sales trigger and pool-funding sources; the Big Block change requires no additional candidate update.
Changing the Big Block draw trigger and identifying qualifying sales does not change the existing per-primary-sale allocation amounts or prize-pool recipients.
The candidate already states that secondary royalties fund prize pools, while the source does not alter royalty enforcement, the flat royalty, founder allocation, or ticket-generation rule.
The Big Block draw trigger and pool-funding change does not alter what transfers with an NFT or the treatment of expired tickets on transfer.
The source leaves the $5 coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, and wallet delivery semantics unchanged.
The Big Block trigger and funding-source change does not alter the one-click claim method, Winners page announcement, or claim URL.
The Big Block prize change does not affect the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.
The source retains the exact $15 mint price and does not make the Big Block trigger or funding rules part of the buyer-facing price.
The FAQ requirement already directs publication of the complete message-143 Q&A, including the stated Big Block details, so no additional state change is needed.
The Big Block draw and funding rules do not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The source's Big Block changes do not alter badge thresholds, award destination, or the first-mint and first-referral badge rules.
The source continues to require both Small and Big Block ticket counters and does not change which reward counters appear in NFT metadata.
